def transform(grid):
    # Rotate the source 180 degrees, then mirror-repeat its indices on both axes.
    n = len(grid)
    base = [row[::-1] for row in grid[::-1]]
    indices = list(range(n)) + list(range(n - 1, -1, -1))
    indices = (indices + list(range(n)))[:3 * n]
    return [[base[indices[r]][indices[c]] for c in range(3 * n)] for r in range(3 * n)]
